_comment: Editor layout for the general composable FCS model (GeneralFCSModel). PRD-62: pick a diffusion type (Gauss, MDF, or two-focus Gauss, each also taking bunching/anticorrelation relaxation terms). The diffusion_mode choice carries rebuild_on_change, so picking a mode schedules a deferred AutoForm.rebuild(); each diffusion panel's hidden_when (not_equals its own mode) then hides the whole panel (header included) live — only the active mode's panel is even visible.

sections.title: Diffusion

sections.label: Type
sections.description: MDF = Enderlein Gauss-Lorentz molecule-detection function (accurate absolute Veff/concentration). Gauss = classic single-focus 3D-Gaussian PSF approximation (the default). Two-focus = classic Dertinger dual-focus technique (same 3D-Gaussian term, known inter-focus distance yields an absolute D).
descriptions: Gauss-Lorentz molecule detection function (absolute volume and concentration).
Dual-focus 3-D Gaussian with known inter-focus distance (absolute D).

sections.description: Diffusion model and the focus geometry it assumes.

sections.title: Equation

sections.description: The compound fitting equation currently active: the selected diffusion term times any active bunching/anticorrelation factors.
The correlation equation currently active (diffusion, triplet / bunching terms), or the catalogue / typed Python equation for a user-defined model.

sections.title: MDF (Gauss-Lorentz)
sections.description: Parameters of the Gauss-Lorentz molecule detection function: focal radius w0 (nm), z0 / aspect ratio and the diffusion times.

sections.title: 3D Gaussian (single-focus)
sections.description: Single-focus 3-D Gaussian PSF: diffusion time t_diff (ms), structure parameter z0/w0 and number of molecules N.

sections.title: Diffusion species (sum of components)

sections.description: Amplitude x_i and diffusion coefficient D_i per component; the amplitudes are normalised. The components share the focus (w_r, w_z) because they are one molecule in one volume, not two species.
Diffusing species: diffusion time (ms) or D, and the fraction/brightness of each component.

sections.title: 3D Gaussian (two-focus)
sections.description: Two-focus 3-D Gaussian model: diffusion time, focal radii and the known inter-focus distance (nm).

sections.title: Bunching terms
sections.description: Photophysical bunching terms (triplet, blinking): amplitude and relaxation time (us) each.

sections.title: Anticorr terms
sections.description: Antibunching / anticorrelation terms (e.g. FRET dynamics): negative amplitude and relaxation time (us).

sections.title: Outputs (MDF mode)
sections.description: Read-only derived quantities of the MDF fit: effective volume Veff, concentration and diffusion coefficient.
